in_hebrew.name: תיאודורה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם תיאודורה מורכב משתי מילים יווניות, 'תεος' (אלוהים) ו-'דωρα' (מתנה), ומשמעותו 'מתנה של אלוהים' או 'מתנה לאלוהים'. השם נמצא בשימוש בקרב הנוצרים והוא מבטא את הרעיון של מתנה אלוהית והערכה לאלוהים.

in_greek.name: Θεοδώρα
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Θεοδώρα προέρχεται από τις ελληνικές λέξεις 'θεός' (Θεός) και 'δωρά' (δώρο), που σημαίνει 'δώρο από τον Θεό' ή 'δώρο του Θεού'. Στην παράδοση της Εκκλησίας, το όνομα Θεοδώρα αντανακλά την πίστη και την ευγνωμοσύνη προς τον Θεό για το δώρο της ζωής και της σωτηρίας.

in_latin.name: Theodora
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Theodora derivatur ex vocibus Graecis 'θεός' (Deus) et 'δωρά' (donum), significans 'donum Dei' seu 'munus Dei'. In traditione Christiana, nomen Theodora exprimit fidem et gratiam erga Deum pro dono vitae et salutis.

in_english.name: Theodora
in_english.long_meaning: Theodora originates from the Greek words 'theos' (θεός), meaning God, and 'doros' (δῶρος), meaning gift. Thus, Theodora signifies 'gift of God' or 'divine gift'. Historically, the name has been used in Christian tradition to express gratitude and devotion to God. It symbolizes a child as a precious gift from God, embodying spiritual significance and divine blessing.

data.cultural_impact: The name Theodora has a rich history that spans continents and time periods. Born in the Greek-speaking Eastern Roman Empire during the late 5th century AD, Theodora rose to power and became the empress consort of Emperor Justinian I. Her rule, along with her husband Justinian, is considered a golden age in both Roman and European history. This period saw significant advancements in law, architecture, and art that continue to influence Western civilization to this day.
data.spiritual_significance: Theodora's name holds deep spiritual significance. As a Christian, Theodora's name embodies the belief in God's divine intervention and providence. The name signifies that the bearer is a gift from God, representing the idea that each person has a purpose in the world and that their life is meaningful and valuable. Additionally, the name serves as a reminder of the importance of gratitude and humility, acknowledging that all good things come from God.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Theodora: God's gift of a woman. Derived from the Greek words "theos" (God) and "doron" (gift), conveying the idea of a divine bestowal upon women.
